def map_celltype_to_broad_group(cell_type: str) -> str:
    s = (cell_type or "").lower()
    if any(k in s for k in ["cd4", "cd8", "t cell", " t ", "treg", "th", "trm"]) or s.strip().startswith("t"):
        return "T"
    if any(k in s for k in ["b cell", " b ", "naive b", "memory b"]) or s.strip().startswith("b"):
        return "B"
    if "nk" in s or "natural killer" in s:
        return "NK"
    if any(k in s for k in ["mono", "macro", "dendritic", "dc", "myelo", "neutro", "granulo", "mast precursor", "m1", "m2"]):
        return "myeloid"
    if any(k in s for k in ["epi", "keratino", "basal", "luminal"]):
        return "epithelial"
    if any(k in s for k in ["endo", "vascular"]):
        return "endothelial"
    if any(k in s for k in ["fibro", "stromal", "myofibro"]):
        return "fibroblast"
    if "mast" in s:
        return "mast"
    if "plasma" in s:
        return "plasma"
    return ""


def build_marker_groups_and_sets(
    genes_index: List[str],
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int],
    canon_set: Set[str],
    alias_to_canon: Dict[str, str]
) -> Tuple[List[Dict], Dict[str, Dict]]:
    df = pd.read_excel(CELL_MARKER_PATH)
    # Filter human
    if "species" in df.columns:
        mask_human = df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("homo") | df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("human")
        df = df[mask_human].copy() if not df[mask_human].empty else df.copy()

    group_to_gene_counts: Dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
    group_to_gene_symbols: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        cell_type = str(row["cell_type"]) if "cell_type" in row and pd.notnull(row["cell_type"]) else ""
        group = map_celltype_to_broad_group(cell_type)
        if not group:
            continue
        symbols: List[str] = []
        if "Symbol" in row and pd.notnull(row["Symbol"]) and str(row["Symbol"]).strip():
            symbols = [str(row["Symbol"])]
        elif "marker" in row and pd.notnull(row["marker"]) and str(row["marker"]).strip():
            symbols = split_genes_field(str(row["marker"]))
        # Canonicalize symbols
        symbols = canonicalize_gene_list(symbols, canon_set, alias_to_canon)
        # Keep only those present in dataset (by base canonical)
        ds_symbols = []
        for sym in symbols:
            if sym in base_canon_to_first_index:
                ds_symbols.append(sym)
        if not ds_symbols:
            continue
        # Update counts and union set
        for sym in ds_symbols:
            group_to_gene_counts[group][sym] += 1
        group_to_gene_symbols[group].update(ds_symbols)

    # Exclusivity assignment
    groups_order = ["T", "B", "NK", "myeloid", "epithelial", "endothelial", "fibroblast", "mast", "plasma"]
    group_priority = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(groups_order)}
    all_groups = list(group_to_gene_symbols.keys())
    # Build gene -> candidate groups mapping
    gene_to_groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    for g, genes in group_to_gene_symbols.items():
        for sym in genes:
            gene_to_groups[sym].append(g)

    # Assign each gene to the group with lowest count (more specific); tie by priority
    assigned_group_to_syms: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {g: set() for g in all_groups}
    for sym, cand_groups in gene_to_groups.items():
        if len(cand_groups) == 1:
            assigned_group_to_syms[cand_groups[0]].add(sym)
        else:
            # pick group with min count
            counts = [(group_to_gene_counts[g][sym], g) for g in cand_groups]
            min_count = min(c for c, _ in counts)
            tied = [g for c, g in counts if c == min_count]
            if len(tied) == 1:
                chosen = tied[0]
            else:
                chosen = sorted(tied, key=lambda x: group_priority.get(x, 1e6))[0]
            assigned_group_to_syms[chosen].add(sym)

    # Build marker sets (one per group) within size bounds
    marker_sets = []
    marker_groups_json = {"groups": []}
    for g in groups_order:
        if g not in assigned_group_to_syms:
            continue
        syms = assigned_group_to_syms[g]
        # Size filters for marker: retain 5–200 after intersection
        if len(syms) < 5 or len(syms) > 200:
            continue
        name = f"{g} marker program"
        desc = f"Broad {g} cell marker union (exclusive assignments)"
        marker_sets.append({
            "name": name,
            "source": "Marker",
            "category": "marker",
            "description": desc,
            "genes_symbols": sorted(list(syms)),
            "size_total": len(syms),
            "is_marker": True,
            "parent_group": g
        })
        # groups JSON to be populated later with set_ids after IDs assigned
        marker_groups_json["groups"].append({
            "group_id": g,
            "name": name,
            "set_ids": [],  # will be filled after set IDs assignment
            "genes": []     # will be filled with canonical names aligned to dataset
        })
    # Build a mapping from group name to the JSON entry for later filling
    group_json_index = {entry["group_id"]: entry for entry in marker_groups_json["groups"]}
    return marker_sets, group_json_index


def set_priority_value(source: str) -> int:
    # Lower value means higher priority
    # Hallmark > Reactome/KEGG > GO > NeST > Marker > Other
    if source == "MSigDB_Hallmark":
        return 0
    if source in ("MSigDB_Reactome", "MSigDB_KEGG"):
        return 1
    if source == "GO":
        return 2
    if source == "NeST":
        return 3
    if source == "Marker":
        return 4
    return 5


def build_set_universe(
    all_sets: List[Dict],
    genes_index: List[str],
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int],
    marker_group_json_map: Dict[str, Dict]
) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[List[int]]]:
    n_genes = len(genes_index)
    # Intersect with dataset genes and apply size filters
    filtered_sets: List[Dict] = []
    set_genes_indices: List[Set[int]] = []
    for s in all_sets:
        # Map symbols to indices using base canonical -> first index
        idxs = []
        for sym in s["genes_symbols"]:
            if sym in base_canon_to_first_index:
                idxs.append(base_canon_to_first_index[sym])
        idxs_set = set(idxs)
        size_in_ds = len(idxs_set)
        # Size filters
        if s["is_marker"]:
            if size_in_ds < 5 or size_in_ds > 200:
                continue
        else:
            if size_in_ds < 15 or size_in_ds > 300:
                continue
            # Also drop sets with <8 genes after intersection (stricter)
            if size_in_ds < 8:
                continue
        if size_in_ds == 0:
            continue
        s2 = s.copy()
        s2["size_in_dataset"] = size_in_ds
        filtered_sets.append(s2)
        set_genes_indices.append(idxs_set)

    # Redundancy pruning by Jaccard, greedy by priority and size
    order = sorted(
        list(range(len(filtered_sets))),
        key=lambda i: (
            set_priority_value(filtered_sets[i]["source"]),
            -filtered_sets[i]["size_in_dataset"],
            -filtered_sets[i]["size_total"]
        )
    )
    kept_indices = []
    kept_sets: List[Dict] = []
    kept_sets_genes: List[Set[int]] = []
    for idx in order:
        cand_genes = set_genes_indices[idx]
        redundant = False
        for kg in kept_sets_genes:
            # Jaccard threshold 0.8
            inter = len(cand_genes & kg)
            if inter == 0:
                continue
            union_sz = len(cand_genes | kg)
            j = inter / union_sz if union_sz > 0 else 0.0
            if j >= 0.8:
                redundant = True
                break
        if not redundant:
            kept_indices.append(idx)
            kept_sets.append(filtered_sets[idx])
            kept_sets_genes.append(cand_genes)

    # Assign set IDs and finalize
    final_sets: List[Dict] = []
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]] = []
    for i, (s, genes_set) in enumerate(zip(kept_sets, kept_sets_genes), start=1):
        sid = f"S{i:06d}"
        s3 = s.copy()
        s3["set_id"] = sid
        final_sets.append(s3)
        final_set_genes_indices.append(sorted(list(genes_set)))
        # If marker, add to marker_groups json mapping
        if s3["is_marker"] and s3["parent_group"] in marker_group_json_map:
            marker_group_json_map[s3["parent_group"]]["set_ids"].append(sid)
            # Populate genes by their index names (canonical gene_index items)
            s_gene_names = [genes_index[idx] for idx in sorted(list(genes_set))]
            marker_group_json_map[s3["parent_group"]]["genes"] = s_gene_names

    return final_sets, final_set_genes_indices


def build_incidence_matrices(
    final_sets: List[Dict],
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]],
    n_genes: int
) -> Tuple[sp.csr_matrix, sp.csr_matrix]:
    # Build CSR boolean mask M (n_sets x n_genes)
    n_sets = len(final_sets)
    indptr = [0]
    indices = []
    data = []
    for gene_idx_list in final_set_genes_indices:
        indices.extend(gene_idx_list)
        data.extend([True] * len(gene_idx_list))
        indptr.append(len(indices))
    M = sp.csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=bool), np.array(indices, dtype=np.int32), np.array(indptr, dtype=np.int32)),
                      shape=(n_sets, n_genes), dtype=bool)
    # Weighted W with IDF and row-normalized (L2)
    # Compute frequency per gene across sets
    M_csc = M.tocsc()
    freq = np.diff(M_csc.indptr).astype(np.int32)  # length n_genes
    n_sets_float = float(n_sets)
    idf = np.log((1.0 + n_sets_float) / (1.0 + freq.astype(np.float32)))
    W = M.tocsr(copy=True).astype(np.float32)
    # Replace non-zeros with idf[col]
    W.data = idf[W.indices].astype(np.float32)
    # Row-normalize (L2)
    row_ptr = W.indptr
    vals = W.data
    for i in range(n_sets):
        start, end = row_ptr[i], row_ptr[i+1]
        if end > start:
            norm = float(np.linalg.norm(vals[start:end]))
            if norm > 0.0:
                vals[start:end] /= norm
    return M, W


def build_gene_graph(
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]],
    n_genes: int,
    jaccard_threshold: float = 0.1,
    top_k: int = 20
) -> Tuple[sp.csr_matrix, sp.csr_matrix]:
    # Build gene->sets mapping and degrees
    n_sets = len(final_set_genes_indices)
    gene_to_sets: List[List[int]] = [[] for _ in range(n_genes)]
    for s_idx, gene_list in enumerate(final_set_genes_indices):
        for g in gene_list:
            gene_to_sets[g].append(s_idx)
    deg = np.array([len(gene_to_sets[i]) for i in range(n_genes)], dtype=np.int32)

    # Prepare set index -> gene list for fast access
    set_to_genes = [np.array(gl, dtype=np.int32) for gl in final_set_genes_indices]

    rows, cols, data = [], [], []
    # For symmetric normalized Laplacian, we'll construct raw symmetric adjacency using Jaccard
    for i in range(n_genes):
        d_i = deg[i]
        if d_i == 0:
            continue
        neighbor_counts: Dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for s in gene_to_sets[i]:
            g_list = set_to_genes[s]
            # Increment counts for co-members
            for j in g_list:
                if j == i:
                    continue
                neighbor_counts[j] += 1
        if not neighbor_counts:
            continue
        # Compute Jaccard and keep >= threshold
        weights = []
        for j, c in neighbor_counts.items():
            d_j = deg[j]
            denom = d_i + d_j - c
            if denom <= 0:
                continue
            w = c / denom
            if w >= jaccard_threshold:
                weights.append((j, w))
        if not weights:
            continue
        # Top-k by weight
        if len(weights) > top_k:
            weights.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
            weights = weights[:top_k]
        for j, w in weights:
            rows.append(i)
            cols.append(j)
            data.append(float(w))

    if len(rows) == 0:
        # No edges, return zero adjacency and identity laplacian
        A = sp.csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        L = sp.eye(n_genes, dtype=np.float32, format="csr")
        return A, L

    A_dir = sp.coo_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                          shape=(n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32).tocsr()
    # Symmetrize by max
    A_sym_raw = A_dir.maximum(A_dir.transpose()).tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    # Row-normalize adjacency
    row_sums = np.array(A_sym_raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    rs_inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums, dtype=np.float32)
    nz = row_sums > 0
    rs_inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz].astype(np.float32)
    Dinv = sp.diags(rs_inv, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    A_row_norm = Dinv.dot(A_sym_raw).tocsr().astype(np.float32)

    # Normalized Laplacian L = I - D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} using raw symmetric A
    deg_raw = np.array(A_sym_raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
    d_inv_sqrt = np.zeros_like(deg_raw, dtype=np.float32)
    nz2 = deg_raw > 0
    d_inv_sqrt[nz2] = (1.0 / np.sqrt(deg_raw[nz2])).astype(np.float32)
    D_inv_sqrt = sp.diags(d_inv_sqrt, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    sym_norm = (D_inv_sqrt.dot(A_sym_raw).dot(D_inv_sqrt)).tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    I = sp.eye(n_genes, dtype=np.float32, format="csr")
    L = (I - sym_norm).tocsr().astype(np.float32)

    return A_row_norm, L


def write_gene_index_json(genes_index: List[str], synonyms_map: Dict[str, str], path: str):
    index_map = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(genes_index)}
    obj = {
        "genes": genes_index,
        "index": index_map,
        "synonyms": synonyms_map
    }
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f)
    # Assert
    assert os.path.exists(path)
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        loaded = json.load(f)
    assert isinstance(loaded, dict)
    assert "genes" in loaded and "index" in loaded and "synonyms" in loaded
    assert isinstance(loaded["genes"], list)
    assert len(loaded["genes"]) == len(genes_index)
    assert isinstance(loaded["index"], dict)
    assert len(loaded["index"]) == len(genes_index)
    # Ensure mapping consistency
    for i, g in enumerate(genes_index):
        assert str(loaded["index"][g]) == str(i)

def write_marker_groups_json(marker_group_json_map: Dict[str, Dict], path: str, genes_index_set: Set[str]):
    # Build groups list
    groups = []
    for g, entry in marker_group_json_map.items():
        # Filter genes that exist in genes_index_set
        ggenes = [gn for gn in entry.get("genes", []) if gn in genes_index_set]
        groups.append({
            "group_id": entry.get("group_id", g),
            "name": entry.get("name", f"{g} marker program"),
            "set_ids": entry.get("set_ids", []),
            "genes": ggenes
        })
    obj = {"groups": groups}
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f)
    # Assert
    assert os.path.exists(path)
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        loaded = json.load(f)
    assert isinstance(loaded, dict)
    assert "groups" in loaded
    assert isinstance(loaded["groups"], list)
    for gr in loaded["groups"]:
        assert "group_id" in gr and "name" in gr and "set_ids" in gr and "genes" in gr
        assert isinstance(gr["set_ids"], list)
        assert isinstance(gr["genes"], list)


def write_qc_drop_genes(qc_genes: List[str], path: str):
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        for g in qc_genes:
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
    assert os.path.exists(path)
    # Read back
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        lines = [l.strip() for l in f.readlines()]
    # Lines can be empty; just ensure it's a list of strings
    assert isinstance(lines, list)


def main():
    os.makedirs(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    # Load meta info
    meta_df = pd.read_csv(META_INFO_PATH)

    # 1) Gene harmonization and index
    genes_index, index_map, synonyms_map, base_canon_to_first_index, canon_set = load_dataset_genes_and_index(meta_df)
    # Write gene index JSON
    write_gene_index_json(genes_index, synonyms_map, GENE_INDEX_JSON)

    # 2) QC drop genes
    qc_genes = build_qc_drop_genes(genes_index, meta_df, base_canon_to_first_index)
    write_qc_drop_genes(qc_genes, QC_DROP_GENES_TXT)

    # 3) Parse resources
    msig_sets = parse_msigdb(base_canon_to_first_index, canon_set, synonyms_map)
    go_sets = parse_go_terms(canon_set, synonyms_map)
    nest_sets = parse_nest(canon_set, synonyms_map)
    marker_sets, marker_group_json_map = build_marker_groups_and_sets(genes_index, base_canon_to_first_index, canon_set, synonyms_map)

    all_sets = msig_sets + go_sets + nest_sets + marker_sets

    # 4) Build set universe and prune redundancy
    final_sets, final_set_genes_indices = build_set_universe(all_sets, genes_index, base_canon_to_first_index, marker_group_json_map)

    # 5) Build incidence matrices
    n_genes = len(genes_index)
    M, W = build_incidence_matrices(final_sets, final_set_genes_indices, n_genes)

    # Assert dimensions are valid
    n_sets = len(final_sets)
    assert M.shape == (n_sets, n_genes)
    assert W.shape == (n_sets, n_genes)

    # 6) Build gene graph (adjacency and Laplacian)
    A_adj, L = build_gene_graph(final_set_genes_indices, n_genes, jaccard_threshold=0.1, top_k=20)

    # 7) Write artifacts
    # set2gene_mask
    write_sparse_npz(M.astype(bool), SET2GENE_MASK_NPZ, (n_sets, n_genes), np.bool_)
    # set2gene_weighted
    write_sparse_npz(W.astype(np.float32), SET2GENE_WEIGHTED_NPZ, (n_sets, n_genes), np.float32)
    # set metadata
    write_set_metadata_csv(final_sets, final_set_genes_indices, SET_METADATA_CSV)
    # adjacency
    write_sparse_npz(A_adj.astype(np.float32), GENE_GRAPH_ADJ_NPZ, (n_genes, n_genes), np.float32)
    # laplacian
    write_sparse_npz(L.astype(np.float32), GENE_GRAPH_LAPLACIAN_NPZ, (n_genes, n_genes), np.float32)
    # marker groups
    write_marker_groups_json(marker_group_json_map, MARKER_GROUPS_JSON, set(genes_index))

    # Additional assertions for adjacency properties
    A_loaded = sp.load_npz(GENE_GRAPH_ADJ_NPZ).tocsr()
    # Row normalization check on non-empty rows
    row_sums = np.array(A_loaded.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    if np.any(row_sums > 0):
        rs = row_sums[row_sums > 0]
        # Allow small numerical deviations
        assert np.allclose(rs, np.ones_like(rs), atol=1e-3)
    # Non-negativity and no self-loops
    if A_loaded.nnz > 0:
        assert np.all(A_loaded.data >= -1e-8)
    A_diag = A_loaded.diagonal()
    if A_diag.size:
        assert np.allclose(A_diag, 0.0, atol=1e-6)

    # Laplacian diagonal non-negative
    L_loaded = sp.load_npz(GENE_GRAPH_LAPLACIAN_NPZ).tocsr()
    diag = L_loaded.diagonal()
    assert np.all(diag >= -1e-6)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Part 2 — Model Architecture and Training
- Overview
  - Prior-guided masked autoencoder for counts with NB likelihood, plus batch-invariance via domain-adversarial loss.
  - Latent Z = [Z_prior (programs), Z_free (unconstrained)].
- Dimensions
  - n_genes = columns in processed data.
  - n_sets = rows in set2gene_mask; Kp = n_sets.
  - Kf (free dims) = 64–96 (default 64).
- Encoder
  - Input: counts with size factor offset; feed log1p-normalized features (layers['log1p']) to stabilization, while decoder models counts.
  - Prior branch (programs):
    - Linear layer W_train (Kp × n_genes) with fixed binary mask M (set2gene_mask); weights outside M clamped to 0.
    - Initialize W_train with set2gene_weighted (row-normalized IDF weights).
    - Nonlinearity: softplus; apply LayerNorm; optional nonnegativity by projecting negatives to 0 after each step.
    - Output Z_prior ∈ R^{Kp}, apply dropout=0.1.
  - Free branch:
    - MLP: n_genes → 512 → 128 → Kf with GELU activations, LayerNorm, dropout=0.1.
    - Optional bottleneck noise (Gaussian) for robustness.
  - Concatenate Z = concat(Z_prior, Z_free). For domain-adversarial, optionally apply gradient reversal on Z.
- Decoder
  - Two-path reconstruction to mean μ:
    - Program decoder: masked transpose (tied weights) or learned masked decoder V_train (n_genes × Kp) with same mask M^T; default tied to W_train^T.
    - Free decoder: linear W_free (n_genes × Kf).
    - Combined logits: η = Z_prior @ V^T + Z_free @ W_free^T + b (per-gene bias).
  - NB output:
    - Per-cell mean μ = sf * softplus(η) with size factor sf from obs['size_factors'].
    - Per-gene dispersion θ (learnable, positive via softplus).
    - Optional zero-inflation π (learnable) if strong dropout; default off unless needed.
- Losses
  - Reconstruction: Negative log-likelihood of NB(counts | μ, θ), weighted by var['qc_weight'] if defined.
  - Laplacian smoothness on gene-loadings: λ_L * tr(W_train L W_train^T), using gene_graph_laplacian L; default λ_L=1e-3.
  - Group lasso on rows of W_train (program sparsity over genes): λ_GL * Σ_s ||W_train[s, :]||_2; default λ_GL=5e-4.
  - L1 sparsity on Z_prior: λ_Z1 * ||Z_prior||_1 per cell; default λ_Z1=5e-3.
  - Marker-group exclusivity:
    - Using marker_groups.json, aggregate group activities g = pool(Z_prior over sets per group, mean).
    - Entropy penalty: λ_EX * H(softmax(g)); default λ_EX=1e-3.
    - Inter-group decorrelation: λ_DC * offdiag_cov(g); default λ_DC=1e-3.
  - Batch invariance (choose one; default adversarial):
    - Adversarial: domain classifier head on Z (2-layer MLP) with cross-entropy; apply gradient reversal; weight λ_ADV=1.0.
    - Or MMD between batches on Z with Gaussian kernel; λ_MMD=1.0 (use if adversarial unstable).
  - Total loss per minibatch: L = L_NB + λ_L*L_lap + λ_GL*L_gl + λ_Z1*L_l1 + λ_EX*L_ent + λ_DC*L_decorr + λ_ADV*L_adv (or λ_MMD*L_mmd).
- Optimization and training
  - Optimizer: Adam (lr=1e-3 for encoder/decoder; lr_mask=5e-4 for W_train to keep close to prior), weight decay=1e-5; gradient clipping=5.0.
  - Batch size: 1,024 cells (adjust for GPU memory).
  - Epochs: up to 300 with early stopping (patience=30 on val total loss).
  - Warm-up schedule:
    - Epochs 0–20: train NB reconstruction only.
    - 20–60: add λ_Z1, λ_GL at half strength.
    - 60+: full regularization; start adversarial/MMD at epoch 40.
  - Checkpoints: save best by val total loss and by val batch-invariance proxy (domain classification accuracy ~ chance).
  - Determinism: set seeds (42), enable cudnn deterministic where applicable, log versions/config.
- Monitoring
  - Track: train/val NB loss, total loss, Z_prior sparsity, adversarial accuracy, per-batch reconstruction loss, and stability of W_train drift from initialization (||W_train − W_init||_F).

  - Use best checkpoint to compute Z for all cells (including test). Use final Z = concat(Z_prior,Z_free) after LayerNorm.

def set_seed(seed: int = 42):
    import random
    import numpy as _np
    random.seed(seed)
    _np.random.seed(seed)


def read_embedding(embedding_path: str, meta_path: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, pd.DataFrame]:
    Z = np.load(embedding_path)
    assert isinstance(Z, np.ndarray) and Z.ndim == 2 and Z.shape[0] > 0 and Z.shape[1] > 0, "Invalid embedding array"
    meta = pd.read_csv(meta_path)
    assert "cell_id" in meta.columns, "embedding_metadata.csv must include 'cell_id' column"
    assert len(meta) == Z.shape[0], "Embedding rows must match metadata rows"
    return Z, meta


def load_preprocessed_anndata(train_path: str, val_path: str, test_path: str) -> ad.AnnData:
    adata_train = ad.read_h5ad(train_path)
    adata_val = ad.read_h5ad(val_path)
    adata_test = ad.read_h5ad(test_path)
    # Concatenate with outer join to preserve all cells/genes; missing entries filled with 0
    adata = ad.concat({"train": adata_train, "val": adata_val, "test": adata_test}, axis=0, label="__split_src__", join="outer")
    # Ensure 'split' column exists and consistent
    if "split" not in adata.obs.columns:
        # Fallback from source keys
        split_map = {"train": "train", "val": "val", "test": "test"}
        adata.obs["split"] = adata.obs["__split_src__"].map(split_map).astype(str)
    adata.obs.drop(columns=["__split_src__"], inplace=True)
    return adata


def align_adata_to_embedding(adata: ad.AnnData, embed_meta: pd.DataFrame) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Ensure all embedding cells exist in adata
    embed_ids = embed_meta["cell_id"].astype(str).tolist()
    adata_ids = adata.obs_names.astype(str).tolist()
    assert set(embed_ids) <= set(adata_ids), "Some embedding cells are not present in AnnData"
    # Reindex adata to embedding order
    adata = adata[embed_ids, :].copy()
    # Sanity: ensure split present
    assert "split" in adata.obs.columns, "AnnData obs must include 'split'"
    return adata


def leiden_cluster_from_embedding(X: np.ndarray, resolution: float, k: int = 30, random_state: int = 42) -> np.ndarray:
    # X: (n_cells x dim)
    ad_tmp = ad.AnnData(X=X.copy())
    sc.pp.neighbors(ad_tmp, n_neighbors=k, use_rep=None, metric="cosine", random_state=random_state)
    sc.tl.leiden(ad_tmp, resolution=resolution, key_added="leiden", random_state=random_state)
    labs = ad_tmp.obs["leiden"].astype("category")
    # Map to ints in category order to ensure deterministic ints
    cat_to_int = {cat: i for i, cat in enumerate(labs.cat.categories)}
    labels_int = labs.astype(str).map(cat_to_int).astype(int).to_numpy()
    return labels_int


def silhouette_on_val(X_val: np.ndarray, labels_val: np.ndarray) -> float:
    unique = np.unique(labels_val)
    if unique.size <= 1:
        return -1.0
    # If any cluster with <2 samples, silhouette_score fails; handle by filtering those labels out for scoring
    counts = pd.Series(labels_val).value_counts().to_dict()
    bad_labels = {lab for lab, cnt in counts.items() if cnt < 2}
    if len(bad_labels) > 0:
        mask = ~np.isin(labels_val, list(bad_labels))
        if mask.sum() < 2 or np.unique(labels_val[mask]).size <= 1:
            return -1.0
        return float(silhouette_score(X_val[mask], labels_val[mask], metric="cosine"))
    return float(silhouette_score(X_val, labels_val, metric="cosine"))


def compute_centroids(X: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> Dict[int, np.ndarray]:
    centroids: Dict[int, np.ndarray] = {}
    for lab in np.unique(labels):
        mask = labels == lab
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            centroids[int(lab)] = X[mask].mean(axis=0)
    return centroids


def map_clusters_hungarian(split_centroids: Dict[int, np.ndarray], ref_centroids: Dict[int, np.ndarray]) -> Dict[int, int]:
    # Build ordered lists
    split_keys = sorted(split_centroids.keys())
    ref_keys = sorted(ref_centroids.keys())
    A = np.stack([split_centroids[k] for k in split_keys], axis=0) if len(split_keys) > 0 else np.zeros((0, 1))
    B = np.stack([ref_centroids[k] for k in ref_keys], axis=0) if len(ref_keys) > 0 else np.zeros((0, 1))

    if A.shape[0] == 0 or B.shape[0] == 0:
        return {}

    # Cost = cosine distance
    cost = cosine_distances(A, B)

    # Hungarian on min dimension; build mapping from split->ref
    mapping: Dict[int, int] = {}
    if cost.shape[0] <= cost.shape[1]:
        row_ind, col_ind = linear_sum_assignment(cost)
        for r, c in zip(row_ind, col_ind):
            mapping[split_keys[r]] = ref_keys[c]
        # For any remaining split clusters not assigned (if any), map to nearest ref centroid
        if len(mapping) < len(split_keys):
            for idx, key in enumerate(split_keys):
                if key not in mapping:
                    nearest = int(ref_keys[int(np.argmin(cost[idx]))])
                    mapping[key] = nearest
    else:
        # More split clusters than ref clusters; match using transposed to cover all refs
        row_ind, col_ind = linear_sum_assignment(cost.T)
        # row_ind indexes ref, col_ind indexes split
        matched_split = set()
        for r, c in zip(row_ind, col_ind):
            mapping[split_keys[c]] = ref_keys[r]
            matched_split.add(split_keys[c])
        # Assign any unmatched split to nearest ref
        for idx, key in enumerate(split_keys):
            if key not in matched_split:
                nearest = int(ref_keys[int(np.argmin(cost[idx]))])
                mapping[key] = nearest
    return mapping

def select_best_resolution(Z: np.ndarray, splits: List[str], res_grid: List[float], k: int = 30) -> ResolutionSelectionResult:
    val_mask = np.array([s == "val" for s in splits])
    assert val_mask.any(), "Validation split must have at least one cell"
    X_val = Z[val_mask]
    best_res = res_grid[0]
    best_score = -1.0
    for res in res_grid:
        labels_val = leiden_cluster_from_embedding(X_val, resolution=res, k=k, random_state=42)
        score = silhouette_on_val(X_val, labels_val)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_res = res
    return ResolutionSelectionResult(resolution=float(best_res), silhouette=float(best_score))


def compute_ari(all_labels_true: np.ndarray, all_labels_pred: np.ndarray, splits: List[str]) -> Dict[str, float]:
    ari_all = float(adjusted_rand_score(all_labels_true, all_labels_pred))
    out = {"ari": ari_all}
    for sp in ["train", "val", "test"]:
        m = np.array([s == sp for s in splits])
        if m.sum() > 1 and len(np.unique(all_labels_pred[m])) > 1 and len(np.unique(all_labels_true[m])) > 1:
            out[f"ari_{sp}"] = float(adjusted_rand_score(all_labels_true[m], all_labels_pred[m]))
        else:
            out[f"ari_{sp}"] = float("nan")
    return out

    Kp: int,

    Zp = Z[:, :Kp]
    # Build set_id -> row index mapping (assumes set_metadata has 'set_id' aligned to mask rows)
    set_id_col = "set_id" if "set_id" in set_meta.columns else None
    set_name_col = "name" if "name" in set_meta.columns else set_meta.columns[0]
    set_names = set_meta[set_name_col].astype(str).tolist()

    set_id_to_idx: Dict[str, int] = {}
    if set_id_col is not None:
        set_id_to_idx = {str(sid): int(i) for i, sid in enumerate(set_meta[set_id_col].astype(str).tolist())}

    # Prepare marker groups mapping to set indices
    group_defs = marker_groups.get("groups", [])
    group_to_set_indices: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
    group_name_by_id: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for g in group_defs:
        gid = str(g.get("group_id", g.get("name", "")))
        gname = str(g.get("name", gid))
        group_name_by_id[gid] = gname
        set_ids = g.get("set_ids", [])
        idxs: List[int] = []
        for sid in set_ids:
            sid_str = str(sid)
            if set_id_col is not None and sid_str in set_id_to_idx:
                idxs.append(set_id_to_idx[sid_str])
            else:
                # fallback: try to match by name
                if sid_str in set_names:
                    idxs.append(set_names.index(sid_str))
        if len(idxs) > 0:
            group_to_set_indices[gid] = sorted(set(set_indices for set_indices in idxs))

    res: Dict[str, dict] = {}
    labels_unique = sorted(np.unique(pred_labels).tolist())
    for lab in labels_unique:
        mask = pred_labels == lab
        size = int(mask.sum())
        if size == 0:
            continue
        mean_prog = Zp[mask].mean(axis=0)  # (Kp,)
        # Top programs
        top_idx = np.argsort(-mean_prog)[:min(top_programs_k, Kp)]
        top_programs = []
        for i in top_idx:
            pname = set_names[int(i)] if int(i) < len(set_names) else f"set_{int(i)}"
            pscore = float(mean_prog[int(i)])
            top_programs.append([pname, pscore])
        # Top marker groups
        group_scores: List[Tuple[str, float]] = []
        for gid, idxs in group_to_set_indices.items():
            if len(idxs) == 0:

            scores = mean_prog[np.array(idxs)]
            gscore = float(scores.mean())

    out_sets = []
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        name = str(row["name_new"]) if "name_new" in row and pd.notnull(row["name_new"]) else (str(row["NEST ID"]) if "NEST ID" in row else "NeST_Signature")
        desc = name
        genes_field = row["Genes"] if "Genes" in row else ""
        genes = split_genes_field(genes_field)
        genes = canonicalize_gene_list(genes, canon_set, alias_to_canon)
        source = "NeST"
        category = "state"

            "source": source,

            "genes_symbols": genes,
            "size_total": size_total,
            "is_marker": False,
            "parent_group": ""
        })

def map_celltype_to_broad_group(cell_type: str) -> str:
    s = (cell_type or "").lower()
    if any(k in s for k in ["cd4", "cd8", "t cell", " t ", "treg", "th", "trm"]) or s.strip().startswith("t"):
        return "T"
    if any(k in s for k in ["b cell", " b ", "naive b", "memory b"]) or s.strip().startswith("b"):
        return "B"
    if "nk" in s or "natural killer" in s:
        return "NK"
    if any(k in s for k in ["mono", "macro", "dendritic", "dc", "myelo", "neutro", "granulo", "mast precursor", "m1", "m2"]):
        return "myeloid"
    if any(k in s for k in ["epi", "keratino", "basal", "luminal"]):
        return "epithelial"
    if any(k in s for k in ["endo", "vascular"]):
        return "endothelial"
    if any(k in s for k in ["fibro", "stromal", "myofibro"]):
        return "fibroblast"
    if "mast" in s:
        return "mast"
    if "plasma" in s:
        return "plasma"
    return ""


def build_marker_groups_and_sets(
    genes_index: List[str],
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int],
    canon_set: Set[str],
    alias_to_canon: Dict[str, str]
) -> Tuple[List[Dict], Dict[str, Dict]]:
    df = pd.read_excel(CELL_MARKER_PATH)
    # Filter human
    if "species" in df.columns:
        mask_human = df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("homo") | df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("human")
        df = df[mask_human].copy() if not df[mask_human].empty else df.copy()

    group_to_gene_counts: Dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
    group_to_gene_symbols: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        cell_type = str(row["cell_type"]) if "cell_type" in row and pd.notnull(row["cell_type"]) else ""
        group = map_celltype_to_broad_group(cell_type)
        if not group:
            continue
        symbols: List[str] = []
        if "Symbol" in row and pd.notnull(row["Symbol"]) and str(row["Symbol"]).strip():
            symbols = [str(row["Symbol"])]
        elif "marker" in row and pd.notnull(row["marker"]) and str(row["marker"]).strip():
            symbols = split_genes_field(str(row["marker"]))
        # Canonicalize symbols
        symbols = canonicalize_gene_list(symbols, canon_set, alias_to_canon)
        # Keep only those present in dataset (by base canonical)
        ds_symbols = []
        for sym in symbols:
            if sym in base_canon_to_first_index:
                ds_symbols.append(sym)
        if not ds_symbols:
            continue
        # Update counts and union set
        for sym in ds_symbols:
            group_to_gene_counts[group][sym] += 1
        group_to_gene_symbols[group].update(ds_symbols)

    # Exclusivity assignment
    groups_order = ["T", "B", "NK", "myeloid", "epithelial", "endothelial", "fibroblast", "mast", "plasma"]
    group_priority = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(groups_order)}
    all_groups = list(group_to_gene_symbols.keys())
    # Build gene -> candidate groups mapping
    gene_to_groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    for g, genes in group_to_gene_symbols.items():
        for sym in genes:
            gene_to_groups[sym].append(g)

    # Assign each gene to the group with lowest count (more specific); tie by priority
    assigned_group_to_syms: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {g: set() for g in all_groups}
    for sym, cand_groups in gene_to_groups.items():
        if len(cand_groups) == 1:
            assigned_group_to_syms[cand_groups[0]].add(sym)
        else:
            # pick group with min count
            counts = [(group_to_gene_counts[g][sym], g) for g in cand_groups]
            min_count = min(c for c, _ in counts)
            tied = [g for c, g in counts if c == min_count]
            if len(tied) == 1:
                chosen = tied[0]
            else:
                chosen = sorted(tied, key=lambda x: group_priority.get(x, 1e6))[0]
            assigned_group_to_syms[chosen].add(sym)

    # Build marker sets (one per group) within size bounds
    marker_sets = []
    marker_groups_json = {"groups": []}
    for g in groups_order:
        if g not in assigned_group_to_syms:
            continue
        syms = assigned_group_to_syms[g]
        # Size filters for marker: retain 5–200 after intersection
        if len(syms) < 5 or len(syms) > 200:
            continue
        name = f"{g} marker program"
        desc = f"Broad {g} cell marker union (exclusive assignments)"
        marker_sets.append({
            "name": name,
            "source": "Marker",
            "category": "marker",
            "description": desc,
            "genes_symbols": sorted(list(syms)),
            "size_total": len(syms),
            "is_marker": True,
            "parent_group": g
        })
        # groups JSON to be populated later with set_ids after IDs assigned
        marker_groups_json["groups"].append({
            "group_id": g,
            "name": name,
            "set_ids": [],  # will be filled after set IDs assignment
            "genes": []     # will be filled with canonical names aligned to dataset
        })
    # Build a mapping from group name to the JSON entry for later filling
    group_json_index = {entry["group_id"]: entry for entry in marker_groups_json["groups"]}
    return marker_sets, group_json_index


def set_priority_value(source: str) -> int:
    # Lower value means higher priority
    # Hallmark > Reactome/KEGG > GO > NeST > Marker > Other
    if source == "MSigDB_Hallmark":
        return 0
    if source in ("MSigDB_Reactome", "MSigDB_KEGG"):
        return 1
    if source == "GO":
        return 2
    if source == "NeST":
        return 3
    if source == "Marker":
        return 4
    return 5


def build_set_universe(
    all_sets: List[Dict],
    genes_index: List[str],
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int],
    marker_group_json_map: Dict[str, Dict]
) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[List[int]]]:
    n_genes = len(genes_index)
    # Intersect with dataset genes and apply size filters
    filtered_sets: List[Dict] = []
    set_genes_indices: List[Set[int]] = []
    for s in all_sets:
        # Map symbols to indices using base canonical -> first index
        idxs = []
        for sym in s["genes_symbols"]:
            if sym in base_canon_to_first_index:
                idxs.append(base_canon_to_first_index[sym])
        idxs_set = set(idxs)
        size_in_ds = len(idxs_set)
        # Size filters
        if s["is_marker"]:
            if size_in_ds < 5 or size_in_ds > 200:
                continue
        else:
            if size_in_ds < 15 or size_in_ds > 300:
                continue
            # Also drop sets with <8 genes after intersection (stricter)
            if size_in_ds < 8:
                continue
        if size_in_ds == 0:
            continue
        s2 = s.copy()
        s2["size_in_dataset"] = size_in_ds
        filtered_sets.append(s2)
        set_genes_indices.append(idxs_set)

    # Redundancy pruning by Jaccard, greedy by priority and size
    order = sorted(
        list(range(len(filtered_sets))),
        key=lambda i: (
            set_priority_value(filtered_sets[i]["source"]),
            -filtered_sets[i]["size_in_dataset"],
            -filtered_sets[i]["size_total"]
        )
    )
    kept_indices = []
    kept_sets: List[Dict] = []
    kept_sets_genes: List[Set[int]] = []
    for idx in order:
        cand_genes = set_genes_indices[idx]
        redundant = False
        for kg in kept_sets_genes:
            # Jaccard threshold 0.8
            inter = len(cand_genes & kg)
            if inter == 0:
                continue
            union_sz = len(cand_genes | kg)
            j = inter / union_sz if union_sz > 0 else 0.0
            if j >= 0.8:
                redundant = True
                break
        if not redundant:
            kept_indices.append(idx)
            kept_sets.append(filtered_sets[idx])
            kept_sets_genes.append(cand_genes)

    # Assign set IDs and finalize
    final_sets: List[Dict] = []
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]] = []
    for i, (s, genes_set) in enumerate(zip(kept_sets, kept_sets_genes), start=1):
        sid = f"S{i:06d}"
        s3 = s.copy()
        s3["set_id"] = sid
        final_sets.append(s3)
        final_set_genes_indices.append(sorted(list(genes_set)))
        # If marker, add to marker_groups json mapping
        if s3["is_marker"] and s3["parent_group"] in marker_group_json_map:
            marker_group_json_map[s3["parent_group"]]["set_ids"].append(sid)
            # Populate genes by their index names (canonical gene_index items)
            s_gene_names = [genes_index[idx] for idx in sorted(list(genes_set))]
            marker_group_json_map[s3["parent_group"]]["genes"] = s_gene_names

    return final_sets, final_set_genes_indices


def build_incidence_matrices(
    final_sets: List[Dict],
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]],
    n_genes: int
) -> Tuple[sp.csr_matrix, sp.csr_matrix]:
    # Build CSR boolean mask M (n_sets x n_genes)
    n_sets = len(final_sets)
    indptr = [0]
    indices = []
    data = []
    for gene_idx_list in final_set_genes_indices:
        indices.extend(gene_idx_list)
        data.extend([True] * len(gene_idx_list))
        indptr.append(len(indices))
    M = sp.csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=bool), np.array(indices, dtype=np.int32), np.array(indptr, dtype=np.int32)),
                      shape=(n_sets, n_genes), dtype=bool)
    # Weighted W with IDF and row-normalized (L2)
    # Compute frequency per gene across sets
    M_csc = M.tocsc()
    freq = np.diff(M_csc.indptr).astype(np.int32)  # length n_genes
    n_sets_float = float(n_sets)
    idf = np.log((1.0 + n_sets_float) / (1.0 + freq.astype(np.float32)))
    W = M.tocsr(copy=True).astype(np.float32)
    # Replace non-zeros with idf[col]
    W.data = idf[W.indices].astype(np.float32)
    # Row-normalize (L2)
    row_ptr = W.indptr
    vals = W.data
    for i in range(n_sets):
        start, end = row_ptr[i], row_ptr[i+1]
        if end > start:
            norm = float(np.linalg.norm(vals[start:end]))
            if norm > 0.0:
                vals[start:end] /= norm
    return M, W


def build_gene_graph(
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]],
    n_genes: int,
    jaccard_threshold: float = 0.1,
    top_k: int = 20
) -> Tuple[sp.csr_matrix, sp.csr_matrix]:
    # Build gene->sets mapping and degrees
    n_sets = len(final_set_genes_indices)
    gene_to_sets: List[List[int]] = [[] for _ in range(n_genes)]
    for s_idx, gene_list in enumerate(final_set_genes_indices):
        for g in gene_list:
            gene_to_sets[g].append(s_idx)
    deg = np.array([len(gene_to_sets[i]) for i in range(n_genes)], dtype=np.int32)

    # Prepare set index -> gene list for fast access
    set_to_genes = [np.array(gl, dtype=np.int32) for gl in final_set_genes_indices]

    rows, cols, data = [], [], []
    # For symmetric normalized Laplacian, we'll construct raw symmetric adjacency using Jaccard
    for i in range(n_genes):
        d_i = deg[i]
        if d_i == 0:
            continue
        neighbor_counts: Dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for s in gene_to_sets[i]:
            g_list = set_to_genes[s]
            # Increment counts for co-members
            for j in g_list:
                if j == i:
                    continue
                neighbor_counts[j] += 1
        if not neighbor_counts:
            continue
        # Compute Jaccard and keep >= threshold
        weights = []
        for j, c in neighbor_counts.items():
            d_j = deg[j]
            denom = d_i + d_j - c
            if denom <= 0:
                continue
            w = c / denom
            if w >= jaccard_threshold:
                weights.append((j, w))
        if not weights:
            continue
        # Top-k by weight
        if len(weights) > top_k:
            weights.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
            weights = weights[:top_k]
        for j, w in weights:
            rows.append(i)
            cols.append(j)
            data.append(float(w))

    if len(rows) == 0:
        # No edges, return zero adjacency and identity laplacian
        A = sp.csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        L = sp.eye(n_genes, dtype=np.float32, format="csr")
        return A, L

    A_dir = sp.coo_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                          shape=(n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32).tocsr()
    # Symmetrize by max
    A_sym_raw = A_dir.maximum(A_dir.transpose()).tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    # Row-normalize adjacency
    row_sums = np.array(A_sym_raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    rs_inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums, dtype=np.float32)
    nz = row_sums > 0
    rs_inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz].astype(np.float32)
    Dinv = sp.diags(rs_inv, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    A_row_norm = Dinv.dot(A_sym_raw).tocsr().astype(np.float32)

    # Normalized Laplacian L = I - D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} using raw symmetric A
    deg_raw = np.array(A_sym_raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
    d_inv_sqrt = np.zeros_like(deg_raw, dtype=np.float32)
    nz2 = deg_raw > 0
    d_inv_sqrt[nz2] = (1.0 / np.sqrt(deg_raw[nz2])).astype(np.float32)
    D_inv_sqrt = sp.diags(d_inv_sqrt, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    sym_norm = (D_inv_sqrt.dot(A_sym_raw).dot(D_inv_sqrt)).tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    I = sp.eye(n_genes, dtype=np.float32, format="csr")
    L = (I - sym_norm).tocsr().astype(np.float32)

    return A_row_norm, L

    row_sums = np.array(A_loaded.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    if np.any(row_sums > 0):
        rs = row_sums[row_sums > 0]
        # Allow small numerical deviations
        assert np.allclose(rs, np.ones_like(rs), atol=1e-3)
    # Non-negativity and no self-loops
    if A_loaded.nnz > 0:

    # Laplacian diagonal non-negative
    L_loaded = sp.load_npz(GENE_GRAPH_LAPLACIAN_NPZ).tocsr()

Part 2 — Model Architecture and Training
- Overview
  - Prior-guided masked autoencoder for counts with NB likelihood, plus batch-invariance via domain-adversarial loss.
  - Latent Z = [Z_prior (programs), Z_free (unconstrained)].
- Dimensions
  - n_genes = columns in processed data.
  - n_sets = rows in set2gene_mask; Kp = n_sets.
  - Kf (free dims) = 64–96 (default 64).
- Encoder
  - Input: counts with size factor offset; feed log1p-normalized features (layers['log1p']) to stabilization, while decoder models counts.
  - Prior branch (programs):
    - Linear layer W_train (Kp × n_genes) with fixed binary mask M (set2gene_mask); weights outside M clamped to 0.
    - Initialize W_train with set2gene_weighted (row-normalized IDF weights).
    - Nonlinearity: softplus; apply LayerNorm; optional nonnegativity by projecting negatives to 0 after each step.
    - Output Z_prior ∈ R^{Kp}, apply dropout=0.1.
  - Free branch:
    - MLP: n_genes → 512 → 128 → Kf with GELU activations, LayerNorm, dropout=0.1.
    - Optional bottleneck noise (Gaussian) for robustness.
  - Concatenate Z = concat(Z_prior, Z_free). For domain-adversarial, optionally apply gradient reversal on Z.
- Decoder
  - Two-path reconstruction to mean μ:
    - Program decoder: masked transpose (tied weights) or learned masked decoder V_train (n_genes × Kp) with same mask M^T; default tied to W_train^T.
    - Free decoder: linear W_free (n_genes × Kf).
    - Combined logits: η = Z_prior @ V^T + Z_free @ W_free^T + b (per-gene bias).
  - NB output:
    - Per-cell mean μ = sf * softplus(η) with size factor sf from obs['size_factors'].
    - Per-gene dispersion θ (learnable, positive via softplus).
    - Optional zero-inflation π (learnable) if strong dropout; default off unless needed.
- Losses
  - Reconstruction: Negative log-likelihood of NB(counts | μ, θ), weighted by var['qc_weight'] if defined.
  - Laplacian smoothness on gene-loadings: λ_L * tr(W_train L W_train^T), using gene_graph_laplacian L; default λ_L=1e-3.
  - Group lasso on rows of W_train (program sparsity over genes): λ_GL * Σ_s ||W_train[s, :]||_2; default λ_GL=5e-4.
  - L1 sparsity on Z_prior: λ_Z1 * ||Z_prior||_1 per cell; default λ_Z1=5e-3.
  - Marker-group exclusivity:
    - Using marker_groups.json, aggregate group activities g = pool(Z_prior over sets per group, mean).
    - Entropy penalty: λ_EX * H(softmax(g)); default λ_EX=1e-3.
    - Inter-group decorrelation: λ_DC * offdiag_cov(g); default λ_DC=1e-3.
  - Batch invariance (choose one; default adversarial):
    - Adversarial: domain classifier head on Z (2-layer MLP) with cross-entropy; apply gradient reversal; weight λ_ADV=1.0.
    - Or MMD between batches on Z with Gaussian kernel; λ_MMD=1.0 (use if adversarial unstable).
  - Total loss per minibatch: L = L_NB + λ_L*L_lap + λ_GL*L_gl + λ_Z1*L_l1 + λ_EX*L_ent + λ_DC*L_decorr + λ_ADV*L_adv (or λ_MMD*L_mmd).
- Optimization and training
  - Optimizer: Adam (lr=1e-3 for encoder/decoder; lr_mask=5e-4 for W_train to keep close to prior), weight decay=1e-5; gradient clipping=5.0.
  - Batch size: 1,024 cells (adjust for GPU memory).
  - Epochs: up to 300 with early stopping (patience=30 on val total loss).
  - Warm-up schedule:
    - Epochs 0–20: train NB reconstruction only.
    - 20–60: add λ_Z1, λ_GL at half strength.
    - 60+: full regularization; start adversarial/MMD at epoch 40.
  - Checkpoints: save best by val total loss and by val batch-invariance proxy (domain classification accuracy ~ chance).
  - Determinism: set seeds (42), enable cudnn deterministic where applicable, log versions/config.
- Monitoring
  - Track: train/val NB loss, total loss, Z_prior sparsity, adversarial accuracy, per-batch reconstruction loss, and stability of W_train drift from initialization (||W_train − W_init||_F).

def to_upper(s: str) -> str:
    return s.upper().strip() if isinstance(s, str) else s


def split_genes_field(field: str) -> List[str]:
    if not isinstance(field, str):
        return []
    # Split by semicolon, comma, whitespace
    parts = re.split(r"[;,\t\r\n ]+", field)
    genes = [to_upper(p) for p in parts if p and isinstance(p, str)]
    return [g for g in genes if len(g) > 0]


def build_gene_canonicalization(meta_df: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[Set[str], Dict[str, str]]:
    # Build canonical symbol set and alias->canonical map from meta_info.csv
    # Use summary_symbol as canonical; 'gene' column entries map to summary_symbol
    canon = set()
    alias_to_canon = {}
    # Filter human if species provided; else use all
    if "species" in meta_df.columns:
        mask_human = meta_df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("homo") | meta_df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("human")
        meta_use = meta_df[mask_human].copy()
        if meta_use.empty:
            meta_use = meta_df.copy()
    else:
        meta_use = meta_df.copy()

    # Uppercase relevant columns
    if "summary_symbol" in meta_use.columns:
        canon_series = meta_use["summary_symbol"].astype(str).map(to_upper)
        canon |= set(canon_series.tolist())
    if "gene" in meta_use.columns and "summary_symbol" in meta_use.columns:
        for _, row in meta_use.iterrows():
            alias = to_upper(str(row["gene"]))
            canonical = to_upper(str(row["summary_symbol"]))
            if alias and canonical:
                alias_to_canon[alias] = canonical
                canon.add(canonical)
    # Map some standard aliases for mitochondria and ribosomal if not present
    return canon, alias_to_canon


def canonicalize_gene_list(genes: List[str], canon_set: Set[str], alias_to_canon: Dict[str, str]) -> List[str]:
    out = []
    for g in genes:
        gu = to_upper(g)
        if gu in canon_set:
            out.append(gu)
        elif gu in alias_to_canon:
            out.append(alias_to_canon[gu])
        else:
            out.append(gu)
    return out


def load_dataset_genes_and_index(meta_df: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[List[str], Dict[str, int], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, int], Dict[str, str]]:
    adata = ad.read_h5ad(INPUT_MOD1)
    dataset_genes_orig = [to_upper(x) for x in list(adata.var_names.astype(str).tolist())]
    canon_set, alias_to_canon = build_gene_canonicalization(meta_df)

    # Map dataset genes to canonical; ensure uniqueness by appending suffix for duplicates
    genes_index: List[str] = []
    index_map: Dict[str, int] = {}
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int] = {}
    used_names: Set[str] = set()
    dup_counts: Dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)

    for i, g in enumerate(dataset_genes_orig):
        if g in canon_set:
            canon = g
        elif g in alias_to_canon:
            canon = alias_to_canon[g]
        else:
            canon = g
        # Ensure uniqueness of name in gene index
        name = canon
        if name in used_names:
            dup_counts[name] += 1
            name = f"{canon}__DUP{dup_counts[canon]}"
        if canon not in base_canon_to_first_index:
            base_canon_to_first_index[canon] = len(genes_index)
        genes_index.append(name)
        index_map[name] = len(genes_index) - 1
        used_names.add(name)

    # synonyms map: include alias->canonical (base canonical)
    synonyms_map = alias_to_canon.copy()

    return genes_index, index_map, synonyms_map, base_canon_to_first_index, canon_set


def build_qc_drop_genes(genes_index: List[str], meta_df: pd.DataFrame, base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int]) -> List[str]:
    genes_set = set(genes_index)
    # Determine QC genes: mitochondrial (MT- prefix or chrM), ribosomal (RPS/RPL), MALAT1
    mito_genes = set([g for g in genes_index if g.startswith("MT-") or g.startswith("MT_")])
    ribo_genes = set([g for g in genes_index if g.startswith("RPS") or g.startswith("RPL")])
    other_qc = set()
    if "summary_chromosome" in meta_df.columns and "summary_symbol" in meta_df.columns:
        # Filter human rows
        if "species" in meta_df.columns:
            mask_human = meta_df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("homo") | meta_df["species"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("human")
            meta_use = meta_df[mask_human].copy()
            if meta_use.empty:
                meta_use = meta_df.copy()
        else:
            meta_use = meta_df.copy()
        for _, row in meta_use.iterrows():
            chrom = str(row["summary_chromosome"]) if pd.notnull(row["summary_chromosome"]) else ""
            sym = to_upper(str(row["summary_symbol"])) if pd.notnull(row["summary_symbol"]) else ""
            if sym and (chrom.upper() in ["MT", "CHRM", "M", "MITOCHONDRIAL"]):
                # Use base canonical to first index name
                if sym in base_canon_to_first_index:
                    # name in genes_index may be canonical or with __DUP; get the first canonical name at that index
                    idx = base_canon_to_first_index[sym]
                    mito_genes.add(genes_index[idx])
    # Special MALAT1
    if "MALAT1" in base_canon_to_first_index:
        idx = base_canon_to_first_index["MALAT1"]
        other_qc.add(genes_index[idx])

    qc = sorted(list((mito_genes | ribo_genes | other_qc) & genes_set))
    return qc

def map_celltype_to_broad_group(cell_type: str) -> str:
    s = (cell_type or "").lower()
    if any(k in s for k in ["cd4", "cd8", "t cell", " t ", "treg", "th", "trm"]) or s.strip().startswith("t"):
        return "T"
    if any(k in s for k in ["b cell", " b ", "naive b", "memory b"]) or s.strip().startswith("b"):
        return "B"
    if "nk" in s or "natural killer" in s:
        return "NK"
    if any(k in s for k in ["mono", "macro", "dendritic", "dc", "myelo", "neutro", "granulo", "mast precursor", "m1", "m2"]):
        return "myeloid"
    if any(k in s for k in ["epi", "keratino", "basal", "luminal"]):
        return "epithelial"
    if any(k in s for k in ["endo", "vascular"]):
        return "endothelial"
    if any(k in s for k in ["fibro", "stromal", "myofibro"]):
        return "fibroblast"
    if "mast" in s:
        return "mast"
    if "plasma" in s:
        return "plasma"
    return ""


def build_marker_groups_and_sets(
    genes_index: List[str],
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int],
    canon_set: Set[str],
    alias_to_canon: Dict[str, str]

    df = pd.read_excel(CELL_MARKER_PATH)

        df = df[mask_human].copy() if not df[mask_human].empty else df.copy()

    group_to_gene_counts: Dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
    group_to_gene_symbols: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        cell_type = str(row["cell_type"]) if "cell_type" in row and pd.notnull(row["cell_type"]) else ""
        group = map_celltype_to_broad_group(cell_type)
        if not group:
            continue
        symbols: List[str] = []
        if "Symbol" in row and pd.notnull(row["Symbol"]) and str(row["Symbol"]).strip():
            symbols = [str(row["Symbol"])]
        elif "marker" in row and pd.notnull(row["marker"]) and str(row["marker"]).strip():
            symbols = split_genes_field(str(row["marker"]))

        symbols = canonicalize_gene_list(symbols, canon_set, alias_to_canon)

        ds_symbols = []
        for sym in symbols:

        for sym in ds_symbols:

    group_priority = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(groups_order)}

    gene_to_groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)

    # Assign each gene to the group with lowest count (more specific); tie by priority
    assigned_group_to_syms: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {g: set() for g in all_groups}
    for sym, cand_groups in gene_to_groups.items():
        if len(cand_groups) == 1:
            assigned_group_to_syms[cand_groups[0]].add(sym)
        else:

            counts = [(group_to_gene_counts[g][sym], g) for g in cand_groups]
            min_count = min(c for c, _ in counts)
            tied = [g for c, g in counts if c == min_count]
            if len(tied) == 1:
                chosen = tied[0]
            else:
                chosen = sorted(tied, key=lambda x: group_priority.get(x, 1e6))[0]

    for g in groups_order:

        syms = assigned_group_to_syms[g]

        marker_sets.append({
            "name": name,
            "source": "Marker",
            "category": "marker",
            "description": desc,
            "genes_symbols": sorted(list(syms)),
            "size_total": len(syms),
            "is_marker": True,
            "parent_group": g
        })
        # groups JSON to be populated later with set_ids after IDs assigned
        marker_groups_json["groups"].append({
            "group_id": g,
            "name": name,
            "set_ids": [],  # will be filled after set IDs assignment
            "genes": []     # will be filled with canonical names aligned to dataset
        })
    # Build a mapping from group name to the JSON entry for later filling
    group_json_index = {entry["group_id"]: entry for entry in marker_groups_json["groups"]}
    return marker_sets, group_json_index


def set_priority_value(source: str) -> int:
    # Lower value means higher priority
    # Hallmark > Reactome/KEGG > GO > NeST > Marker > Other
    if source == "MSigDB_Hallmark":
        return 0
    if source in ("MSigDB_Reactome", "MSigDB_KEGG"):
        return 1
    if source == "GO":
        return 2
    if source == "NeST":
        return 3
    if source == "Marker":
        return 4
    return 5


def build_set_universe(
    all_sets: List[Dict],
    genes_index: List[str],
    base_canon_to_first_index: Dict[str, int],
    marker_group_json_map: Dict[str, Dict]
) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[List[int]]]:
    n_genes = len(genes_index)
    # Intersect with dataset genes and apply size filters
    filtered_sets: List[Dict] = []
    set_genes_indices: List[Set[int]] = []
    for s in all_sets:
        # Map symbols to indices using base canonical -> first index
        idxs = []
        for sym in s["genes_symbols"]:
            if sym in base_canon_to_first_index:
                idxs.append(base_canon_to_first_index[sym])
        idxs_set = set(idxs)
        size_in_ds = len(idxs_set)
        # Size filters
        if s["is_marker"]:
            if size_in_ds < 5 or size_in_ds > 200:
                continue
        else:
            if size_in_ds < 15 or size_in_ds > 300:
                continue
            # Also drop sets with <8 genes after intersection (stricter)
            if size_in_ds < 8:
                continue
        if size_in_ds == 0:
            continue
        s2 = s.copy()
        s2["size_in_dataset"] = size_in_ds
        filtered_sets.append(s2)
        set_genes_indices.append(idxs_set)

    # Redundancy pruning by Jaccard, greedy by priority and size
    order = sorted(
        list(range(len(filtered_sets))),
        key=lambda i: (
            set_priority_value(filtered_sets[i]["source"]),
            -filtered_sets[i]["size_in_dataset"],
            -filtered_sets[i]["size_total"]
        )
    )
    kept_indices = []
    kept_sets: List[Dict] = []
    kept_sets_genes: List[Set[int]] = []
    for idx in order:
        cand_genes = set_genes_indices[idx]
        redundant = False
        for kg in kept_sets_genes:
            # Jaccard threshold 0.8
            inter = len(cand_genes & kg)
            if inter == 0:
                continue
            union_sz = len(cand_genes | kg)
            j = inter / union_sz if union_sz > 0 else 0.0
            if j >= 0.8:
                redundant = True
                break
        if not redundant:
            kept_indices.append(idx)
            kept_sets.append(filtered_sets[idx])
            kept_sets_genes.append(cand_genes)

    # Assign set IDs and finalize
    final_sets: List[Dict] = []
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]] = []
    for i, (s, genes_set) in enumerate(zip(kept_sets, kept_sets_genes), start=1):
        sid = f"S{i:06d}"
        s3 = s.copy()
        s3["set_id"] = sid
        final_sets.append(s3)
        final_set_genes_indices.append(sorted(list(genes_set)))
        # If marker, add to marker_groups json mapping
        if s3["is_marker"] and s3["parent_group"] in marker_group_json_map:
            marker_group_json_map[s3["parent_group"]]["set_ids"].append(sid)
            # Populate genes by their index names (canonical gene_index items)
            s_gene_names = [genes_index[idx] for idx in sorted(list(genes_set))]
            marker_group_json_map[s3["parent_group"]]["genes"] = s_gene_names

    return final_sets, final_set_genes_indices


def build_incidence_matrices(
    final_sets: List[Dict],
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]],
    n_genes: int
) -> Tuple[sp.csr_matrix, sp.csr_matrix]:
    # Build CSR boolean mask M (n_sets x n_genes)
    n_sets = len(final_sets)
    indptr = [0]
    indices = []
    data = []
    for gene_idx_list in final_set_genes_indices:
        indices.extend(gene_idx_list)
        data.extend([True] * len(gene_idx_list))
        indptr.append(len(indices))
    M = sp.csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=bool), np.array(indices, dtype=np.int32), np.array(indptr, dtype=np.int32)),
                      shape=(n_sets, n_genes), dtype=bool)
    # Weighted W with IDF and row-normalized (L2)
    # Compute frequency per gene across sets
    M_csc = M.tocsc()
    freq = np.diff(M_csc.indptr).astype(np.int32)  # length n_genes
    n_sets_float = float(n_sets)
    idf = np.log((1.0 + n_sets_float) / (1.0 + freq.astype(np.float32)))
    W = M.tocsr(copy=True).astype(np.float32)
    # Replace non-zeros with idf[col]
    W.data = idf[W.indices].astype(np.float32)
    # Row-normalize (L2)
    row_ptr = W.indptr
    vals = W.data
    for i in range(n_sets):
        start, end = row_ptr[i], row_ptr[i+1]
        if end > start:
            norm = float(np.linalg.norm(vals[start:end]))
            if norm > 0.0:
                vals[start:end] /= norm
    return M, W


def build_gene_graph(
    final_set_genes_indices: List[List[int]],
    n_genes: int,
    jaccard_threshold: float = 0.1,
    top_k: int = 20
) -> Tuple[sp.csr_matrix, sp.csr_matrix]:
    # Build gene->sets mapping and degrees
    n_sets = len(final_set_genes_indices)
    gene_to_sets: List[List[int]] = [[] for _ in range(n_genes)]
    for s_idx, gene_list in enumerate(final_set_genes_indices):
        for g in gene_list:
            gene_to_sets[g].append(s_idx)
    deg = np.array([len(gene_to_sets[i]) for i in range(n_genes)], dtype=np.int32)

    # Prepare set index -> gene list for fast access
    set_to_genes = [np.array(gl, dtype=np.int32) for gl in final_set_genes_indices]

    rows, cols, data = [], [], []
    # For symmetric normalized Laplacian, we'll construct raw symmetric adjacency using Jaccard
    for i in range(n_genes):
        d_i = deg[i]
        if d_i == 0:
            continue
        neighbor_counts: Dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for s in gene_to_sets[i]:
            g_list = set_to_genes[s]
            # Increment counts for co-members
            for j in g_list:
                if j == i:
                    continue
                neighbor_counts[j] += 1
        if not neighbor_counts:
            continue
        # Compute Jaccard and keep >= threshold
        weights = []
        for j, c in neighbor_counts.items():
            d_j = deg[j]
            denom = d_i + d_j - c
            if denom <= 0:
                continue
            w = c / denom
            if w >= jaccard_threshold:
                weights.append((j, w))
        if not weights:
            continue
        # Top-k by weight
        if len(weights) > top_k:
            weights.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
            weights = weights[:top_k]
        for j, w in weights:
            rows.append(i)
            cols.append(j)
            data.append(float(w))

    if len(rows) == 0:
        # No edges, return zero adjacency and identity laplacian
        A = sp.csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        L = sp.eye(n_genes, dtype=np.float32, format="csr")
        return A, L

    A_dir = sp.coo_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                          shape=(n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32).tocsr()
    # Symmetrize by max
    A_sym_raw = A_dir.maximum(A_dir.transpose()).tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    # Row-normalize adjacency
    row_sums = np.array(A_sym_raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    rs_inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums, dtype=np.float32)
    nz = row_sums > 0
    rs_inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz].astype(np.float32)
    Dinv = sp.diags(rs_inv, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    A_row_norm = Dinv.dot(A_sym_raw).tocsr().astype(np.float32)

    # Normalized Laplacian L = I - D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} using raw symmetric A
    deg_raw = np.array(A_sym_raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
    d_inv_sqrt = np.zeros_like(deg_raw, dtype=np.float32)
    nz2 = deg_raw > 0
    d_inv_sqrt[nz2] = (1.0 / np.sqrt(deg_raw[nz2])).astype(np.float32)
    D_inv_sqrt = sp.diags(d_inv_sqrt, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    sym_norm = (D_inv_sqrt.dot(A_sym_raw).dot(D_inv_sqrt)).tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    I = sp.eye(n_genes, dtype=np.float32, format="csr")
    L = (I - sym_norm).tocsr().astype(np.float32)

    return A_row_norm, L

    # Row normalization check on non-empty rows
    row_sums = np.array(A_loaded.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    if np.any(row_sums > 0):
        rs = row_sums[row_sums > 0]
        # Allow small numerical deviations
        assert np.allclose(rs, np.ones_like(rs), atol=1e-3)
    # Non-negativity and no self-loops
    if A_loaded.nnz > 0:
        assert np.all(A_loaded.data >= -1e-8)
    A_diag = A_loaded.diagonal()
    if A_diag.size:
        assert np.allclose(A_diag, 0.0, atol=1e-6)

    # Laplacian diagonal non-negative
    L_loaded = sp.load_npz(GENE_GRAPH_LAPLACIAN_NPZ).tocsr()

    assert np.all(diag >= -1e-6)
